brief.headline: Push market-fair ask band (₹0.65–0.80/pc) and qualify Manjushree as second source — Bprex publishes no financials so lean on market evidence and a strong alternate.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for pricing in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at our volumes.
priceAsk.basis: Market ask shows typical band of ₹0.85–0.95/pc with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec; verdict is MARKET-FAIR so our target sits at the favourable end justified by our scale.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep current 30 days after receipt; no tightening needed.

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex is a private supplier and publishes no financials, so we cannot measure how healthy or cash-tight they are, or how large we are to them. That limits how hard we can push on payment terms. Instead, we build our price ask on the market evidence — the ask band shows room at higher volume — and on lining up a credible second source. With no visibility into their balance sheet, the smart play is a firm but fair price ask backed by the market, and qualifying Manjushree or Mold-Tek in parallel so we are not dependent on one opaque supplier.

evidence.point: Market ask for 28 mm induction-wad PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
evidence.figure: askBand: ₹0.55–1.20/pc; typical: ₹0.85–0.95/pc; verdict: MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 lakh a year with Bprex, giving us scale to ask for better-than-typical pricing
HDPE resin import unit value currently sits at 87.61 ₹/kg, providing a transparent raw-material benchmark
Bprex does not publish financials, so we cannot assess their health or our importance to them

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, does pharma bottles and caps, health score B (65/100) — top second-source candidate to reduce single-supplier risk.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue with strong pharma capability in bottles and closures, health score B (73/100) — a robust and profitable alternate.

risks: No public financials means we fly blind on Bprex's stability — if they hit trouble we may not see it coming, so a qualified second source is essential insurance.
Market ask verdict is MARKET-FAIR with only modest headroom — pushing too hard past ₹0.65/pc may meet resistance unless we commit higher volume or relax a spec.

Our current 30-day terms already free up ₹5.20 lakh in cash for us versus immediate payment; tightening terms further offers only ₹2.60 lakh more and may strain an opaque supplier whose cash position we cannot see.

Market backups listed (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads to qualify — not yet verified, audited or priced — so treat each as a research starting-point, not an approved source.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to discuss aligning your 28 mm cap pricing to the ₹0.65–0.80 range the market shows at scale, and at the same time we're qualifying a second source to de-risk our supply — let's talk about how we keep this partnership strong while hitting that target.
